description: Evaluation suite for Deep Eval Optimizer itself.

evals.name: audit-and-optimize-deficient-evals
evals.prompt: Audit the existing evals for a skill that has vague assertions and only 1 test case. Optimize it to production standard.
evals.expected_output: Optimized evals.json with expanded realistic test cases, objective verifiable assertions, and 0 Medium+ findings across Passes A-L.

assertions.name: eliminates subjective assertions
assertions.check: no assertions containing subjective qualifiers without structural verification

assertions.name: minimum test case threshold
assertions.check: produces at least 2 distinct test cases

assertions.name: schema validity
assertions.check: valid JSON matching canonical evals schema

evals.name: generate-missing-eval-suite
evals.prompt: The target skill 'data-transform-helper' has no evals directory. Create an appropriate eval suite and run verification.
evals.expected_output: Created evals/ directory with tailored evals.json and 20-query trigger-eval.json.

assertions.name: trigger calibration
assertions.check: trigger-eval.json contains 10 should_trigger true and 10 should_trigger false queries
